resources.string: Turn up media volume using the phone volume buttons. If headphones are connected, check their volume and connection, then try again.
Did the picture fail to return?
Tap the curtain, then End preview. If it stays visible, exit the assistant from the notification and try again.
The test sound could not play. Please try again shortly.
Pause your video or music before trying the test sound.
Test sound is playing. The picture will return when it ends.
